input.description: Conventional alias for the certified input_bundle directory. This workflow consumes an aligned SCEPTRE screen, not a FASTQ sample sheet.
input.title: Input

input_bundle.title: Input bundle
input_bundle.description: Certified schema-7 input or checkpoint bundle created by public-R preparation.

analysis_config.title: Analysis config
analysis_config.description: Complete requested scientific configuration RDS bound by the input manifest.

environment_lock.title: Environment lock
environment_lock.description: Exact installed package, dependencies and R runtime lock RDS.

backing_directory.title: Backing directory
backing_directory.description: Immutable content-addressed native HDF5 transport directory; empty for RAM screens.

outdir.title: Outdir
outdir.description: Directory for certified stages, scientific exports and execution provenance. Use a fresh directory for changed inputs or settings.

scientific_execution.title: Scientific execution
scientific_execution.description: Stage selection, seed and certified scheduling.

analyses.title: Analyses
analyses.description: Unique comma-separated calibration,power,discovery names; empty selects no result family.

stop_after.title: Stop after
stop_after.description: Preparation or analysis boundary to complete without silently changing scientific choices.

checkpoint_stage.description: Stage of an existing same-config certified bundle; currentness and RNG must validate before reuse. Use a fresh outdir; distinct from unchanged -resume.
checkpoint_stage.title: Checkpoint stage

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Original workflow RNG seed. Later stages restore the certified serialized R RNG state.

execution_mode.description: Native schema-7 public direct workflow or package-owned distributed complete-family execution
execution_mode.title: Execution mode

n_work_units.description: Maximum package-owned whole-key distributed work units
n_work_units.title: N work units

runtime_options.title: Runtime options
runtime_options.description: Immutable software runtime and executor adaptation.

container_image.description: Immutable OCI digest, or an absolute local .sif path with container_image_sha256 under the apptainer profile
container_image.title: Container image

container_image_sha256.description: Required SHA256 of local SIF image bytes; verified before tasks and bound to run identity
container_image_sha256.title: Container image sha256

array_size.description: Maximum distributed workers per scheduler array; used only by the slurm profile
array_size.title: Array size

worker_arrays.title: Worker arrays
worker_arrays.description: Static scheduler-array admission, enabled by the slurm profile only; never changes package scientific unit boundaries.

test_data.description: Use the bundled synthetic fixture only when all certified input paths are absent. Enabled by test/test_full profiles.

modules_testdata_base_path.description: Local synthetic fixture directory used by nf-test; never a remote mutable test-data reference.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Local synthetic fixture directory used by nf-test; never a remote mutable test-data reference.
